message:
Let a plugin's dimension finish the picture its own way

A plugin may ask for its colours to be shown as they are (no tone
curve) and for less glow while you are in a dimension of its own, and
hand cvoid's own look back when you leave.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add the void's voice, screen effects, plugins, and a smoother, stranger void

The void is an archivist: its character (persona/void.md, kept local)
colours every sector dreamt from then on, and now and then it speaks in
the fog, written by Claude from what you have been doing; a local
stand-in says much the same without Claude.

The entity has two quiet habits with the sound, in every dimension:
seldom it bends the pitch of everything a little and lets it drift
back; more often it opens the space up into a wide hall of reverb.

Plugins: local additions in plugins/<name>/ (ignored by git) can serve
files and routes, add a dimension of their own, and hook into the
frame, the keys and mouse, the flight, the HUD, the map and the void's
voice. Without any, nothing changes.

Flying:
- screen effects in the Tab panel: crt, vhs, pixel, phosphor, grain
- a faint crosshair; H hides the HUD and leaves it
- forward is faster, holding Space climbs faster, Shift tapped twice
  surges harder, and the right mouse button held zooms in
- the wind is quieter and softer

Smoother: sectors are built one a frame, nearest first; a sky's field
is checked off the main thread and a fading sky is never dropped; the
sky's pattern carries on unbroken through portals and jumps; dust fades
in; the air eases more slowly; resolution follows the typical frame,
not one stall. The zone's ring is filled with the void's violet.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Restyle the volume slider, and leave the hub without floating words

The volume slider is a lit hairline with a small hollow square for a
handle, centred under the start prompt; the map panel's matches it.
The three lines that hung in the air at the origin are gone.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add the zone, solid structures, a fuller map, and clouds round the dark rooms

The zone, reached through a ring of blocks straight down from the hub:
a dimension with a well in it and a falling-block game that is part of
the place. Cleared lines burst out as blocks that drift with the stage's
current, landings shake them, and the Zone stops time for all of it.
Seven stages of our own; whatever is put in zone/ (ignored by git)
becomes the stages instead: music layers, pictures, models, stage.json.

The void:
- structures are solid: flying into one bounces you off with a knock
- roll, level out, volume control, and a way back to the hub from anywhere
- the map remembers where you have been, zooms out over thousands of
  sectors, and can take you to a picked spot or set where you start
- sky changes ease in and out, survive quick sector changes, and the new
  sky's shader is compiled before it is shown, so there is no stall

marderchen's dimension: the dark rooms are grey clouds from outside that
thicken and darken toward the middle; the black only starts inside.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add marderchen's dimension, the museum, and a larger, steadier void

marderchen's dimension, a tribute reached through a portal above the hub:
- his workshop: rainbow matrix, 0603 clock, falling-pixel meowmeter wall,
  chaos generator, his code comments on a wall, his beige mouse vape
- his own code ported with his names (rainbowcalc, ratemal, wuselfarben,
  the chaostyper), his avatar, cats and MEOW sound samples
- a vortex-tunnel museum of his GIFs, Flash (via Ruffle, playing on the
  wall when looked at) and build photos, served from a local mirror
- every wuselcode file as a sector of its own, with its code on a board
- voids with his chaostyper maze, effects he applies, rare takeovers
- a black-hole portal with a smooth fade and his homepage's music

The void: wider sectors, one constant look, dust and sky in empty
sectors, free look over the top, autofly, sector streaming, entity,
map, controller support, and server-side limits on what is served.

His persona, the notes behind it and his own "about me" text stay
local (persona/ and public/marderchen/about.txt are ignored).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Initial commit: cvoid, a generative void to fly through

A browser game after the PlayStation 2 system menu: an endless dark grid of
sectors, each dreamt by Claude (geometry, palette, sky shader, sound, text)
and cached by coordinates.

- Node server proxies Claude and streams sectors geometry-first
- Layered structures from 18 layouts and 10 solids, plus blueprints for
  built things (houses, cities, dream-distorted homages)
- Voids and thin regions from a shared population field
- An entity directed by Claude that appears, speaks and sets rendezvous
- Endless recursion structures, sound-reactive rendering, sector map
- Mouse, keyboard, gamepad and touch controls

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
